item.title: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients
item.description:
📝 SHARE Three people with inoperable pancreatic cancer had stable disease after receiving an experimental virus treatment in a University of Minnesota Phase I trial. It should not be read as proof that every cancer cell was eliminated, that tumors disappeared or that the treatment has been shown to extend survival compared with standard care. Follow up is scheduled every three months for one year after study treatment.
🔗 Read more: https://scienceinhand.com/pancreatic-cancer-halted-by-virus-injection-in-three-patients/
